title: spec(types): the spec's authored properties-bag carriers (flex and the eight object-* public blocks) have zod arms but no TypeScript node type; extend AuthoringNode by reference, as objectui#11364 did for the 27 public blocks
body:
This card carries objectui#8347's **F3** half: TypeScript node types for the authored `properties`-bag carriers. objectui#8347 keeps the removal itself and everything its fork ACCEPT lists for the last PR.

Filing-gate category: ① — a named landing point (`AuthoringNode` in `packages/types/src/authoring-nodes.ts`), measured reach, and named producers. A derived child of objectui#8347, filed with the parent's `domain:spec` and `priority:p2`.
Reader: the `domain:spec @ objectui` seat (objectui#10217) dispatches it, and an os-dev executes it.
Parent: objectui#8347, which is `pm:blocked` until this card and its two siblings land.

## What was measured (objectui#8347's P1 report `5953663875`, at `main` `5988b6b53`)

`FlexBlockSchema` (in `packages/types/src/zod/layout.zod.ts`) and the eight `ObjectQLPublicBlockComponentSchema` arms (`object-metric`, `object-master-detail-form`, `object-timeline`, `object-form`, `object-map`, `object-chart`, `object-gantt`, `object-grid`) have zod arms, which `objectui validate` already enforces, but no TypeScript node type. `AuthoringNode` covers the 27 `PublicBlockComponentSchema` arms, `element:text_input`, `element:record_picker` and page documents only. With `BaseSchema`'s index signature deleted alone:
- **46 doc diagnostics** in `check:doc-snippets`: `plugin-map.mdx` 12, the plugin-grid README 11, `plugin-gantt.mdx` 10, `objectos-integration.mdx` 3, the plugin-form README 2, the plugin-map README 2, the types README 2, utilities 2, the plugin-gantt README 1, and the root README 1. Each types one of these carriers as `BaseSchema`;
- the types example `dashboard.ts`: a `flex` node with its `properties` bag, annotated `BaseSchema`, ×2;
- an inline `SchemaRenderer` literal of any of these nodes.

`reach:` the published `@object-ui/types` face. The named producers are the docs and READMEs above.

## Seat answer: A (non-escalation; it extends a ruled direction)

**Governing text:** objectui#11364's direction A, "TS node types by reference to the spec rows", which PR objectui#11385 executed for the 27 public blocks under an at-tier contract review, and 协议为基准.

- **A:** a node type for each of these arms, BY REFERENCE (the arm's closed input type, the same mechanism `AuthoringNode` uses for the 27 public blocks; ⛔ not hand-written twins), joined into `AuthoringNode`. Docs then annotate the declared node type instead of `BaseSchema`.
- B (drop the annotation, untyped JSON) leaves TypeScript authors with no node type, and the docs stop compiling against any contract.

## Constraints

- Every edit here must compile WITH the signature still present, so this card lands on its own and `main` stays green.
- The listed doc blocks and the types example move with the types.
- objectui#8347's F1 sibling may type node slots and `SchemaRenderer`'s prop as a union that includes `AuthoringNode`. Whichever lands second merges `main`, and the arms added here then flow into that union.
- `Clause-②` is stated at claim from the actual change: a new exported type is public-face growth.

## Dedupe

The same REST read as objectui#8347's siblings (600 most recently updated objectui issues and PRs, open and closed, back to 2026-09-28T12:31Z, 2026-10-02): `FlexBlockSchema` / `ObjectQLPublicBlockComponent` / `AuthoringNode` 10 hits, all closed PRs. Control `objectui` 589.

Dedupe words: `AuthoringNode properties bag carriers` · `FlexBlockSchema TypeScript node type` · `object-map object-gantt TS node type`
